name: Red Wings Widget
description: Detroit Red Wings NHL schedule widget + companion app: next-game countdown, last result, and division standings.
changelog: Reorganized widget division standings into two columns: 1-4 on the left (playoff tier) and 5-8 on the right (wildcard hunt).
Redesigned the widget next-game matchup row: Away team logo + abbreviation on the left, Home team abbreviation + logo on the right.
Replaced generic vs. text with game date & start time (e.g. SAT • 7:00 PM / TODAY • 7:00 PM), @ matchup badge, and big countdown timer.
